scenario: A runaway tram is heading toward ten workers on the main track. Dana can pull a lever that redirects the tram onto a side track, where one worker stands. If she pulls the lever, the tram will kill that worker and spare the ten. If she does not, it will kill the ten and spare the one. Dana cannot stop the tram. Should she pull the lever?
